series_links.why: Same KK number in the same 'Kankan diamonds (Guinea)' series by the same authors; inclusion lists agree

review.method: Both papers' inclusion lists and parageneses compared side by side for all 15 diamonds.

notes.KK-45: Same two inclusions named differently: Kankan II 'MgSiO3 + microcl.', Kankan III 'opx, K-fsp (hollandite?)'. Both kept as each paper reports them.
notes.KK-66: CaSiO3 count differs: Kankan II assemblage '2Fper + CaSiO3', Kankan III '2 Fe-per, 2 CaSiO3'. Both kept as each paper reports them.
notes.KK-84: Paragenesis differs: Kankan II 'l.m.(?)', Kankan III 'Unknown'. Both kept, attributed to each paper.
